description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations -  Industrial Dispute between Inter Company Employees Union and Agio Tobacco Processing Company (Pvt.) Ltd.,
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific labor dispute. It references a specific legal act (Chapter 131), its amendments, and contains a formal legal order issued by the Minister. The core content is about implementing a legal/regulatory framework for dispute resolution, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While a Minister is named, the notice does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the execution of his statutory powers.
